title: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea opened for signature
summary: After nine years of negotiation at the Third UN Conference on the Law of the Sea, the Convention on the Law of the Sea was opened for signature at Montego Bay, Jamaica, on 10 December 1982. It set a legal framework for all ocean space and called the seabed beyond national jurisdiction the common heritage of mankind. It entered into force on 16 November 1994.

uncertainty.note: Opened for signature 10 December 1982; in force 16 November 1994.

as_recorded.value: opened for signature at Montego Bay, Jamaica, on 10 December 1982
